title: Terminal Events
description: The Terminal events reference details the events that arise when payment terminals are registered under a merchant's store in Surfboard. A separate event fires per terminal category — online, softpos (tap to pay), and hardware — so you can tell what kind of terminal was registered from the event name alone. Payloads carry identifiers only; fetch the terminal from the Terminals API when you need its details.

apis.heading: Online Terminal Registered
apis.description: This event is triggered when an online terminal is registered under a store. Online terminals cover the hosted payment page, self-hosted (SDK) integrations, iFrame, and merchant-initiated interfaces. The payload contains identifiers only — fetch the terminal from GET /terminals/{terminalId} when you need its details.

reqParams.name: eventType
reqParams.description: Denotes the category of the webhook event.

reqParams.name: metadata
reqParams.description: Includes information about the webhook event like the unique event ID, the date and time the event was created (timestamp), the number of retry attempts made to send the event, and the specific webhook event ID denoting the type of event.

reqParams.name: eventId
reqParams.description: Unique ID of the webhook event.

reqParams.name: created
reqParams.description: Timestamp at which the event was created.

reqParams.name: retryAttempt
reqParams.description: Number of retry attempts made for the webhook event. Surfboard will attempt to post messages three times in case of failures, with a delay of 5 minutes between the first and second attempts, and a delay of 10 minutes between the second and third attempts.

reqParams.name: originalCreated
reqParams.description: Timestamp of the very first time the event was published

reqParams.name: webhookEventId
reqParams.description: Unique ID of the webhook event.

reqParams.name: data
reqParams.description: The payload in the webhook event that contains the core information or updates being delivered. This is the useful data that recipients can act on.

reqParams.name: terminalId
reqParams.description: Unique identifier of the registered terminal.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: Unique identifier of the merchant that the terminal belongs to.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Unique identifier of the store the terminal is registered under.

apis.heading: SoftPOS Terminal Registered
apis.description: This event is triggered when a softpos (tap-to-pay) terminal is registered under a store — payment acceptance running on a mobile device through the tap-to-pay app or SDK. The payload contains identifiers only — fetch the terminal from GET /terminals/{terminalId} when you need its details.
